_comment: Committed defaults. Put machine-specific overrides (serial ports, phone IP, calibration) in config/local.json (git-ignored).

demo._comment: Slide ids in order. The hub advances through these on gesture or keyboard. Shangran owns this list.

echolocation._comment: Anna. Starting values only; tune on real recordings.
echolocation._devices_comment: Matched by name substring. Speaker = Mac, mic = DJI Mic Mini receiver (USB). Override in config/local.json if names differ.
echolocation._rooms_comment: rooms.json is GENERATED by `python -m services.acoustics.build_rooms` from assets/building/trace_nucleus.json + measurements.json.

matching._comment: Plan B matcher (services/acoustics/match.py). absorption_scale is calibrated on tape-measured rooms; never report on the room you calibrated on.
matching._spans_comment: Wall-to-wall spans from echo pair-sums. Experimental: unreliable in simulation, so reported but not scored until real recordings show they work.

wifi._mac_comment: Required: frames from any other MAC are dropped (venue Wi-Fi interference).

pressure._comment: Phone barometer streamed over HTTP (phyphox remote access) or a CSV export. Set phone_url in config/local.json, e.g. http://192.168.137.12 .
pressure._source_comment: board = flight-controller barometer plugged into the laptop over USB (services/pressure/board.py); phyphox = the phone.

survey._comment: Measured in the Nucleus on 7 Nov 2026 with the phone barometer. Absolute values drift with weather: only the deltas are reused. Re-zero at the reference floor before the demo.

aircraft_optional._comment: OPTIONAL stretch (Kameran, only after gestures work): plane sounds -> which part of Edinburgh. Not part of the core demo.
